fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled access road off the I-70 / PA Turnpike New Stanton interchange roundabout, crossing a bridge over Sewickley Creek; Street View shows 'ALL TRUCK TRAFFIC KEEP RIGHT' and 'SPEED LIMIT 15' signage directing trucks into the property — a controlled industrial entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolvable at the property line; Street View coverage stops at the public bridge and the gate point sits inside the property. The only small structure visible is mid-yard. Marked remoteGs / no shack at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Long dock bank on the west building face plus a separate dock bank along the south/north faces of the main building — two distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer staging lot on the NW (50+ trailer stalls) plus angled trailer drop along the north building edge.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail line runs along the east/north property edge with a spur reaching the building.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC building plus a long separate dock building on the west side.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron at the entrance and ample yard width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; left uncertain.
